prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_account_persistence", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_account_persistence": {"headline": "Keep Your Pet Safe Across Logins", "body": "Your pet progress and profile are linked directly to your primary login email.", "hint": "Use this same login on any device to keep your pet status intact.", "button_label": "Continue Adoption", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Account Protected", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Full Bleed Visual Selector: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a full_bleed layout with high-visibility choice cards.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "full_bleed", "headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion", "body": "Select a companion base to start customizing your pet.", "button_label": "Select Pet", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Companion Options", "style": "playful", "role": "pet_choices"}]}}}

   config: {"upload_photos": {"headline": "Upload Photo or Choose Instant Starter", "body": "Upload a photo for custom pet generation or choose a starter template below.", "hint": "Preset choices generate instantly if photo processing is slow.", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Instant Presets", "style": "rounded", "action": "choose"}]}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "story": {"headline": "Welcome to Your Desktop Companion Experience", "body": "Discover how your pet lives on your desktop before choosing your customization path."}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Please sign in with your primary email to avoid duplicate accounts and missing pet progress."}}
5: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Rendering Timer Info: Display an active render timer and estimated setup duration component on the waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "timer", "label": "Desktop Initialization", "style": "plain"}]}}
6: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Name Ownership Copy: Update adoption certificate headline and body text to emphasize pet ownership confirmation and desktop readiness.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Finalize Your Pet's Official Profile", "body": "Your pet configuration is set and ready to be loaded onto your desktop screen.", "button_label": "Complete Adoption"}}
7: [choose_path, incentive] Path Selection Completion Badge Incentive: Add a visual milestone badge to the choose_path screen acknowledging onboarding progress.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Step 1 of 3 Completed", "style": "highlight"}]}}
8: [finish, notification] Home Intro Desktop Launch Notification Badge: Add a desktop launcher ready notification component to home_intro indicating where the pet resides on the screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Your companion is now active in your desktop system tray.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Active on Desktop", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
9: [finish, layout] Home Intro Two Column Layout: Switch home_intro to a two_column layout presenting pet status alongside simple finishing instructions.

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of an account persistence screen inside onboarding.
Redesigns pet selection visually without losing pet choice functionality.
Adds preset selection options on the photo upload screen without violating onboarding requirements.
Reordering onboarding screens is allowed and story screen retains its introductory job.
Adds explanatory hint text on sign-in without requesting new data or dark patterns.
Timer on waiting screen is permitted as it represents an actual generation wait time.
Copy update maintains adoption certificate functionality and official status.
Adding a progress indicator badge to path selection is allowed within onboarding.
Adding desktop launch status notifications on home_intro is allowed.
Layout redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding is permitted.
